def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Identify the common divider color by finding full separator rows/columns.
    colors = set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    div = next(c for c in colors
               if any(all(v == c for v in row) for row in grid)
               and any(all(grid[r][j] == c for r in range(h)) for j in range(w)))
    rs = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == div for v in grid[r])]
    cs = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[r][j] == div for r in range(h))]
    rb, cb = [-1] + rs + [h], [-1] + cs + [w]

    from collections import Counter
    freq = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != div)
    background = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    mark = next((v for v in freq if v != background), background)

    out = []
    for i in range(len(rb)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(cb)-1):
            count = sum(grid[r][c] == mark
                        for r in range(rb[i]+1, rb[i+1])
                        for c in range(cb[j]+1, cb[j+1]))
            row.append(1 if count % 2 else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
